title: Komga
descript: Komga is a media server for comics, manga, bandes dessinees, magazines and eBooks. It scans your library, reads ComicRack/ComicInfo metadata, and serves a web reader with collections, read lists, search, OPDS, Kobo Sync and KOReader Sync. This package runs the official Docker Hub image as a non-root container; the database and your books stay in the application data folder.
release_note: 1. First release: Komga 1.30.0 from Docker Hub, x86_64 + aarch64, non-root.
important: First login: admin@example.com / admin - change it immediately in the user settings. Put comics/books in DockerAppData/komgadocker/data; the database and settings live in .../config. Needs DockerEngine; add a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up config and data before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

zh-hk.descript: Komga 是一個面向漫畫、日漫、歐美漫畫、雜誌和電子書的媒體伺服器。它會掃描書庫、讀取 ComicRack/ComicInfo 元資料，並提供網頁閱讀器、收藏、閱讀清單、搜尋、OPDS、Kobo Sync 與 KOReader Sync。本應用使用 Docker Hub 官方鏡像並以非 root 使用者運行；資料庫與書籍都保存在應用資料目錄。
zh-hk.important: 初始登入：admin@example.com / admin，請立即在使用者設定裡修改。漫畫/書籍放到 DockerAppData/komgadocker/data，資料庫與設定保存在 .../config。需要 DockerEngine；無法存取 Docker Hub 時請先設定鏡像加速。解除安裝並刪除資料前請備份 config 與 data。應用透過局域網 HTTP 存取。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：Komga 1.30.0，來自 Docker Hub，x86_64 + aarch64 雙包，非 root。

data_notes: `config` holds the database, settings and thumbnails; `data` is the library root that contains your comics/books. Copying both folders is a complete backup.
design_notes: **Non-root.** Runs as `1000:1000`; verified on real hardware.
**Two volumes, one port.** `/config` for state, `/data` for the library; only port 25600 is published.
**Fixed image tag**, Docker Hub only, no privileged mode, no host network, no Docker socket.
limitations: Komga does not create a comic library. Put your files into `DockerAppData/komgadocker/data` and add the library folder in the web UI.
The database is SQLite by default. Very large libraries may benefit from more memory; set `JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS` if you need a larger heap.
Plain HTTP on the LAN; do not expose the published port to the internet without a TLS reverse proxy.
